scope: Independent static review of ROOT's one-shot V3 status capture driver. No B query, remote read, test, import, or model/data/array read by this reviewer.

identity_fork_proof.scope: Rebinds the exact V4 reader/template and combined source-review pins; otherwise preserves the V2 driver.

findings.finding: After receiving the terminal metadata map, the driver writes each entry using `write(record / name, raw)`. The allowed map includes nested paths such as `control/PREDICTION_SIDECAR.json`, but `write()` only opens the final path and `main()` creates only the top-level `record` directory. It creates no arm subdirectories, so a successful response fails with `FileNotFoundError` when the first nested sidecar is written.

required_resolution: A versioned driver should create the exact validated arm directories before writing nested metadata, then fsync the created directory entries; preserve one-shot capture and raw-first transport behavior.
